| description = The Iksar Crusaders in East Cabilis are a strange bunch. By that, I mean they are, perhaps not in their entirety... Clerics. Iksar ''clerics''. Not immune to magic either, just beefy. 6/6 spells landed without issue, [[Allure]] and [[Fetter]] lasted pretty much their full durations. The issue came when this guy cast [[Complete Heal]] on himself at 40%. Like where did you learn that one bro??? Far less tanky than any Trooper, but deals less damage due to wearing a shield.

Some have ~8k hp and go down quick to a charmed Trooper, others can go toe to toe. This particular Crusader is of the latter sort, likely having 15k HP.

     Crusader Wonku says, 'Hiss.. You cannot hope defeat a Crusader of Greenmist!!'
